title: simpler-env/SimplerEnv
abstract:
Evaluating and reproducing real-world robot manipulation policies (e.g., RT-1, RT-1-X, Octo) in simulation under common setups (e.g., Google Robot, WidowX+Bridge) (CoRL 2024)

# SimplerEnv: Simulated Manipulation Policy Evaluation Environments for Real Robot Setups [ ](https://colab.research.google.com/github/simpler-env/SimplerEnv/blob/main/example.ipynb) Significant progress has been made in building generalist robot manipulation policies, yet their scalable and reproducible evaluation remains challenging, as real-world evaluation is operationally expensive and inefficient. We propose employing physical simulators as efficient, scalable, and informative complements to real-world evaluations. These simulation evaluations offer valuable quantitative metrics for checkpoint selection, insights into potential real-world policy behaviors or failure modes, and standardized setups to enhance reproducibility. This repository's code is based in the [SAPIEN](https://sapien.ucsd.edu/) simulator and the CPU based [ManiSkill2](https://maniskill2.github.io/) benchmark. We have also integrated the Bridge dataset environments into ManiSkill3, which offers GPU parallelization and can run 10-15x faster than the ManiSkill2 version. For instructions on how to use the GPU parallelized environments and evaluate policies on them, see: https://github.com/simpler-env/SimplerEnv/tree/maniskill3 This repository encompasses 2 real-to-sim evaluation setups: - `Visual Matching` evaluation: Matching real & sim visual appearances for policy evaluation by overlaying real-world images onto simulation backgrounds and adjusting foreground object and robot textures in simulation. - `Variant Aggregation` evaluation: creating different sim environment variants (e.g., different backgrounds, lightings, distractors, table textures, etc) and averaging their results. We hope that our work guides and inspires future real-to-sim evaluation efforts. - [SimplerEnv: Simulated Manipulation Policy Evaluation Environments for Real Robot Setups](#simplerenv-simulated-manipulation-policy-evaluation-environments-for-real-robot-setups) - [Getting Started](#getting-started) - [Installation](#i
abstract_zh: 在构建通用机器人操作策略方面已取得显著进展，但其可扩展且可复现的评估仍具挑战性，因为真实世界评估操作成本高且效率低。我们提出使用物理模拟器作为真实世界评估的高效、可扩展且信息丰富的补充。这些模拟评估为检查点选择提供有价值的定量指标，洞察潜在的真实世界策略行为或失败模式，并通过标准化设置提高可复现性。本仓库代码基于SAPIEN模拟器和基于CPU的ManiSkill2基准。我们还将Bridge数据集环境集成到ManiSkill3中，后者支持GPU并行化，运行速度比ManiSkill2版本快10-15倍。本仓库包含两种真实到模拟的评估设置：'视觉匹配'评估——通过将真实世界图像叠加到模拟背景上并调整模拟中前景物体和机器人纹理，匹配真实与模拟视觉外观以进行策略评估；'变体聚合'评估——创建不同的模拟环境变体（如不同背景、光照、干扰物、桌面纹理等）并平均其结果。我们希望我们的工作能指导和启发未来的真实到模拟评估工作。
tldr_zh: 提出用物理模拟器高效评估机器人操作策略，支持GPU并行加速10-15倍。

>[!abstract] 一句话总结：基于 SAPIEN 模拟器与 ManiSkill2/ManiSkill3 构建真机对应的仿真评测环境，提出两种 real-to-sim 评测方案：Visual Matching（用真实图像叠加仿真背景并调整物体/机器人纹理以对齐视觉外观）与 Variant Aggregation（生成不同背景、光照、干扰物等环境变体并平均结果），在 Google Robot 与 WidowX+Bridge 两套 setup 上评估策略。


# 一、动机

> 通用机器人操作策略（如 RT-1、RT-1-X、Octo）的真机评测成本高、效率低且难以复现，缺少可扩展、可重复的标准化评估手段。


# 二、方法

> 基于 SAPIEN 模拟器与 ManiSkill2/ManiSkill3 构建真机对应的仿真评测环境，提出两种 real-to-sim 评测方案：Visual Matching（用真实图像叠加仿真背景并调整物体/机器人纹理以对齐视觉外观）与 Variant Aggregation（生成不同背景、光照、干扰物等环境变体并平均结果），在 Google Robot 与 WidowX+Bridge 两套 setup 上评估策略。


# 三、核心实验结果

> 在两种真机 setup（Google Robot、WidowX+Bridge）上复现并评测了 RT-1、RT-1-X、Octo 等策略；集成到 ManiSkill3 的 Bridge 环境支持 GPU 并行，运行速度比 ManiSkill2 版本快 10-15 倍；仿真指标可用于 checkpoint 选择并预测真机行为与失败模式（CoRL 2024）。


# 四、对我的启发

> 局限在于仿真与真机仍存在视觉/物理域差，Visual Matching 依赖真实图像、Variant Aggregation 的变体覆盖有限，仿真结论不能完全替代真机；但其低成本、可复现的评测范式为通用操作策略的迭代与跨本体迁移提供了有价值的补充，与具身智能/机器人操作课题高度相关。
